settings.heading: Shipping details
settings.text:
• Burrows Jewellers currently ships within Australia only.
  • Orders over $99 ship free; orders over $250 ship free by express; orders under $99 have a $5 shipping fee.
  • Items are generally dispatched within 1–3 business days. If your order is delayed we will contact you by phone or email. Read our shipping & returns policy.

settings.heading: Our workshop
settings.text: Cleaning, checks, resizing and repairs are done at our own bench in Mildura — never sent away. First resize is free.

settings.heading: Made for life in our Mildura workshop
settings.text: Every piece we sell is cleaned, checked, resized and repaired at our own bench on Langtree Ave — never sent away.
